tagline: The Verified Directory of Event & Wedding Venues That Allow Outside Catering & BYOB
hero_subheadline: Every venue in our directory is review-verified to allow licensed outside caterers, cultural/family cuisine, food trucks, or BYOB alcohol without predatory lock-in.

faqs.question: How do you verify that a venue truly allows outside catering?
faqs.answer: Our AI enrichment pipeline cross-references each venue's rental contract policy and customer review evidence to confirm whether licensed third-party caterers, cultural caterers, or food trucks are permitted without mandatory in-house F&B minimums.

faqs.question: What does 'Zero Corkage / Buyout Fee' mean?
faqs.answer: Many venues advertise 'outside catering allowed' but charge a $15-$35 per-person outside catering buyout fee. Listings tagged 'Zero Corkage / Buyout Fee' charge $0 extra when you bring a licensed caterer or TABC/state-certified bartender.

faqs.question: How can a venue upgrade to a Featured Placement ($30/mo)?
faqs.answer: Verified venue owners can upgrade any listing for $30/month to pin their venue to the top of city and filter results, display a Verified Featured badge, and receive instant SMS/email routing on incoming event quote inquiries.

raw_listings.name: The Willow Grove Conservatory
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Open vendor policy! You may bring any licensed outside caterer or food truck at no additional buyout fee. BYOB beer, wine, and liquor permitted with a TABC certified bartender ($0 corkage fee). Includes a 600 sq ft commercial warming and prep kitchen with ice machine and 220V food truck shore power pad.

raw_listings.name: Eastside Foundry & Courtyards
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: We love Austin food trucks and outside caterers! Bring your own caterer or pull up to 2 food trucks directly into our gated courtyard. BYOB alcohol is welcome with zero corkage fee. Commercial prep kitchen with stainless tables and walk-in cooler included.

raw_listings.name: Barton Creek Limestone Hall
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Outside catering permitted for South Asian, Kosher, Halal, and family-style banquets. Commercial prep kitchen on site. Note: A $500 outside kitchen cleanup fee applies; alcohol must be served through our bar package (no BYOB).

raw_listings.name: Trinity River Industrial Loft
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: 100% open catering and BYOB policy! Bring your favorite taco truck, BBQ pitmaster, or full-service caterer with zero corkage fee and no hidden markups. Includes commercial prep kitchen and drive-in loading bay for food trucks.

raw_listings.name: White Rock Glass Pavilion
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Outside catering allowed from any health-permitted vendor. BYOB beer and wine allowed with zero corkage fee. Staging pantry and commercial prep kitchen available.

raw_listings.name: Bishop Arts Heritage Courtyard
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Bring your own outside caterer or food truck! Courtyard gate opens directly for food truck parking. BYOB permitted ($250 flat bar setup fee).

raw_listings.name: Peachtree Brickworks Atrium
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: We never force you into overpriced banquet chicken. Bring any licensed outside caterer, cultural chef, or food truck with zero corkage fee! BYOB alcohol is fully permitted, and our 800 sq ft commercial prep kitchen has separate vendor load-in.

raw_listings.name: Inman Park Botanical Carriage House
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Outside catering permitted with zero buyout or corkage fee! BYOB alcohol permitted. Includes full commercial prep kitchen.

raw_listings.name: Old Fourth Ward BeltLine Warehouse
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Outside catering and food trucks welcome on our private BeltLine patio! Commercial prep kitchen included; in-house bar required (no BYOB).

raw_listings.name: Sonoran Adobe & Citrus Grove
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Bring your own outside caterer, wood-fired pizza truck, or taco cart! BYOB alcohol allowed with zero corkage fee (buy at Costco/Total Wine and save $4,000+). Commercial prep kitchen and shaded food truck pad included.

raw_listings.name: Roosevelt Row Modern Gallery
raw_listings.raw_policy_and_reviews: Outside catering and food truck friendly! BYOB permitted with zero corkage fee. Prep area available (no commercial hood).

raw_listings.name: Desert Botanical Terrace Hall
